title: Weighting Several Chargeable Drivers on One Car Rental Agreement
content:
Where more than one driver is chargeable on an agreement written on the Car Rental Rate Classes, the chargeable drivers are weighted rather than counted alike. The chargeable drivers are the additional drivers named on the agreement beyond those the agreement carries free, and where the named drivers do not exceed the free count the chargeable drivers are none at all.

**The weighting basis.**

| What stands on the agreement | How the chargeable drivers are weighted |
|---|---|
| Two or more chargeable drivers, on an agreement booking 7 or more rental days | The first chargeable driver at the whole per-day fee, and each further chargeable driver at half of it, being 0.5 of that fee |
| Two or more chargeable drivers, on an agreement booking fewer than 7 rental days | The first chargeable driver at the whole per-day fee, and each further chargeable driver at three quarters of it, being 0.75 of that fee |
| One chargeable driver, or none | Each chargeable driver at the whole per-day fee |

**Input, judgement, output on hypothetical agreements.**

*Three chargeable drivers, a booked period of 9 rental days.* Two or more are chargeable and the agreement books 7 rental days or more, so the first counts at the whole per-day fee and the two further drivers at 0.5 each, giving a weight of 2 drivers in all.

*Three chargeable drivers, a booked period of 4 rental days.* Two or more are chargeable and the agreement books fewer than 7 rental days, so the first counts at the whole per-day fee and the two further drivers at 0.75 each, giving a weight of 2.5 drivers in all.

*Two chargeable drivers, a booked period of exactly 7 rental days.* The agreement books 7 rental days or more, so the second driver counts at 0.5, giving a weight of 1.5 drivers.

*One chargeable driver, any booked period.* The single driver counts at the whole per-day fee, giving a weight of 1 driver.

*No chargeable driver at all.* The weight is none, whatever the booked period.
